title: OMDA — Open Mobile Document Agent Specification
description: Open specification for turning documents into verified, cited records on the phone, readable by any model and any agent: model slots, provenance, evidenced assertions, deterministic verification, on-device store, MCP/AppFunctions/App Intents agent interface, skills manifest, and selective-disclosure exchange over W3C VC 2.0 + SD-JWT. Includes JSON Schemas, registries, examples and Python reference tools.
